adaptable_ideas: Mix a clean grotesk headline with handwritten annotations ('ARCHITECTURAL', arrow to 'NOT SOFTWARE') to signal craft without an illustration-heavy hero.
A single-colour geometric logo on grid paper keeps even the loading state on-brand; morphing its 2x2 glyphs is a cheap loader.
Two-colour (ultramarine + paper beige) illustration that matches the page ground so the hero art reads as part of the page, not a pasted image.
